name: Zero Policy
description: Zero-owned computer-hold gate, action budgets, and the zero.computer.control Gateway method.

controlMethodName.description: Gateway RPC method name exposed for human take/release.

holdToolNames.description: Tool names gated by the human hold. Default: ["computer"].

codeModeToolNames.description: Tool names that can reach the computer through a code-mode `{code}` envelope. Default: ["exec"]. Treated as opaque input: refused during a hold, counted otherwise.

observeActions.description: Computer actions treated as observation (allowed during a hold and exempt from stale-reference gating).

blockedActions.description: Computer actions always refused, regardless of hold state. Default: [].

highRiskActions.description: Actions recorded as high risk for audit/budget review. NOT blocked by default.

maxActionsPerRun.description: Hard ceiling on gated tool calls per run. Default 400.

maxInputActionsPerRun.description: Hard ceiling on input actions per run. Default 200.

requireFreshSnapshotAfterRelease.description: After a human release, refuse every non-observation action until a fresh screenshot. Default true.
